newsitem.title: USA: Key Energy stake cut by FMR group.
newsitem.headline: Key Energy stake cut by FMR group.

text.p: A group led by FMR Corp said Thursday it reduced its stake in Key Energy Group Inc to 3,682,651 common shares or 31.09 percent from 34.64 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the sale of 91,495 common shares between January 14 and January 15 at prices ranging from $13.3134 to $13.4189 per share.
FMR Corp is the parent to Fidelity Management & Research Co, investment adviser to Fidelity Funds.
Key Energy, based in New Brunswick, N.J., is an oilfield services company providing well services for oil producers in West Texas.
